title: Risk of Rain 2
provenance: Reported by PrisedRabbit (highball-db#368, 2026-10-07), Apple M1 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.12, engine x64-crossover26.3-r21, DXMT as the game's own mode in an environment set to D3DMetal with sync none, rated 5 of 5 after 46 minutes. Second report by murilopereirame (highball-db#414, 2026-10-08), Apple M3, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-crossover26.3-r19, the environment in D3DMetal mode with sync none and AVX advertised (the report names DXMT), rated 4 of 5 after 5 hours: frame times a bit uneven, the health bar missing until a mod fixed it. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on DXMT on the Wine 11 engine over 46 minutes, and playable over 5 hours on an M3 with frame times a bit uneven and the health bar missing until the player added the MetalSafeBars mod. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.cause: not measured here. The game's health bars don't draw through the Metal translation layers, CrossOver players see it too.
knownIssues.fix: The MetalSafeBars mod (a BepInEx plugin, github.com/Krabik6/MetalSafeBars) draws the health and shield bars as an overlay and brought them back for one player. r2modmac (github.com/Zard-Studios/r2modmac), a Mac mod manager for Thunderstore, helps install BepInEx and the mod.
